how: Helpers are invited into maintaining the drawings and asked to protect a threatened related work.
A participant answers the chosen location with a short report that the windows have been placed.
The visible acceptance also requests placement instructions, so bare acceptance asking nothing back cannot describe this joining turn.
One commenter calls rebuilding a lost cause, but the moderator answers with a decision to rebuild rather than adopting that judgment.
An individual abandonment suggestion does not establish collective withdrawal, and the recorded move is explained by a treaty instead of insufficient hands.
Participants propose additional drawings and a possible sign identifying their subreddit.
Plan posts and an official announcement circulate designs that a later rebuilding report invokes as schematics.
Choosing a site receives a report of windows placed there.
Official plan publication follows reported placement, so templates can formalize construction already under way rather than first settle design before building.
A member proposes another drawing for others to join, establishing the proposal form of the starter role.
Reported invitation acceptance and placement establish participation but do not preserve the original call and its complete building response.
The retrospective formation account establishes gathering protectors but does not preserve the original starter-to-call exchange.
The standing account needs chat invitations and public reports of chat decisions, while preserving which group's chat made each reported decision.
A visiting group's reported vote must remain attributed to that group rather than counted as formal order adopted by the host.
A single room and a neighbor's reported vote cannot test the model's cross-room prevalence claim.
Suspected hostile bots are discussed, but the cited concept does not show local scripts, spare accounts, or automated placing.
Repair work is visible but no local adoption of machine hands is established, leaving the proposed escalation untestable.
Participants rebuild to schematics, renew protection, and refuse to relinquish a drawing they have maintained.
Placement and rebuilding concern multiple drawings, so their sequence does not establish the complete upkeep mechanism for each drawing.
Participants investigate whether suspected attacking bots belong to a neighbor and receive a denial of known association.
Participants request room near another work and report a six-pixel relocation agreed with neighboring groups.
The room reports relocating its original drawing six pixels under an agreement rather than abandoning it.
The rebuilding announcement explicitly leaves room for negotiation, while later reports specify an agreed relocation.
Neighbors apologize for overlap, report ceding space, and accept leaving a drawing unchanged.
Negotiation and a refusal to move receive explicit promises to keep the drawing separate and leave it unchanged.
A negotiating interlocutor is asked to carry appreciation back to the other group's members.
Participants maintain neighboring art, receive thanks, and report treating the neighboring drawing as an equal repair priority.
A neighbor's reported vote to cede space is followed in the exchange by an offer of building and maintenance help.
Outgoing help is promised after reclaiming local work, so upkeep can delay assistance rather than immediately produce it.
Equal repair priority supports shared upkeep but does not establish how a coalition was constituted or who joined it.
A retrospective statement about shared repair does not establish a pressure-driven transition into coalition membership.
Refusing relocation and receiving agreement to leave the drawing unchanged establish negotiation without demonstrating a host's rule over guests.
Partial group representation and a reported chat agreement do not themselves establish a dispute about who may bind placers.
Negotiation is visible but a subsequent challenge to the negotiators' authority is not established by the reported chat agreement.
Participants explain multiple dispersed copies through traveling-character lore and a scavenger hunt while acknowledging that fellow fans can work against one another.
Invoking fandom lore does not establish continuity with a preexisting room when the room's own account describes formation around protecting the drawing.
Fellow fans working against one another identifies a present placement conflict without establishing an inherited quarrel.
Shared fandom and disagreement over current work do not establish a pre-canvas tie naming an attack target.
A participant recounts forming the canvas subreddit to gather people protecting an existing drawing.
The participant's formation account adds a route from ongoing protective work to creating a venue that gathers its defenders.
The new room routes newcomers' introductions and questions into the moderator's inbox to make participation visible.
Gathering protectors is the stated reason for forming the room, while a host-post flood and containment response cannot be tested here.
The cited appearance work explicitly follows the canvas's end and does not establish an April Fools takeover or parody.
Participants thank protectors, celebrate three drawings surviving, and congratulate their neighbors.
Participants recount forming the protection group and report the drawings' survival without requiring a preserved image to perform memory work.
Placement reports and later congratulations are compatible with completion being celebrated, but their causal connection is not established.
Celebration and recounting coexist without a passage establishing that celebration caused the room to preserve an account.
Participants propose continuing the small drawings through vectors and spreading them across Reddit and beyond.
A moderator cleans the subreddit appearance while regrouping after closure, and a participant approves its drawing-themed styling.
Introduction routing occurred during the event, so only the later appearance work in this mixed theme establishes post-event regrouping.
The reply links celebration of survival to proposed continuation without establishing that making an archive caused continuation.
Cleanup concerns the subreddit appearance and title bar, leaving disputes over editing or preserving the canvas version unobserved.
Requesting that suspected attackers stop and insisting on holding a corner do not establish a local attack call.
A peaceful proposal and agreement to leave the drawing unchanged do not establish taunts, chants, or victory claims against a rival.
Recruitment is visible without a supported transition from recruiting helpers to attacking another work.
Neighborly apology and appeals to suspected attackers occur without a cited local attack call that would test the proposed response mechanism.
Negotiation alongside rebuilding is visible, but a preceding local attack call is unobserved.
The peaceful request and accepted refusal do not establish an attack-triggered sequence of rival contest talk.
